title: Exodus 1:1-6 with the letters of torah highlighted in the Hebrew
summary: Exodus 1:1-6 in English and letter-spaced Hebrew under the heading torah (ת ו ר ה) in colour. One Hebrew letter is enlarged, coloured and underlined in each of four verses: ת in שמות (v1), ו in ויהודה (v2), ר in ירך (v5) and ה in ההוא (v6), which in order spell torah. The verses list the sons of Israel who came to Egypt with Jacob.

text.text: 1 Now these are the names of the sons of Israel who came to Egypt with Jacob; they came each one with his household:
ואלה שמות בני ישראל הבאים מצרימה אתיעקב איש וביתו באו׃
4 Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
5 All the persons who came from the loins of Jacob were seventy in number, but Joseph was already in Egypt.
ויהי כל נפש יצאי ירך יעקב שבעים נפש ויוסף היה במצרים׃
6 Joseph died, and all his brothers and all that generation.
וימת יוסף וכל אחיו וכל הדור ההוא׃

numbers.note: persons who came from the loins of Jacob (seventy in number, Exodus 1:5)

keywords: these are the names of the sons of Israel
uncertain: In Exodus 1:1 the Hebrew shows אתיעקב joined without a space (normally את יעקב); transcribed as shown. Hebrew text is letter-spaced and the yod can look like an apostrophe.
